deployments_detail.use: Kenvue is a client of i-Genie.ai, using its agentic consumer-insights AI (Presto) and native NLP for brand-equity tracking, product CX benchmarking, trend spotting and AI-generated/scored product concepts across 25+ countries and 20+ languages. [i-Genie.ai (Presto)]

Kenvue partnered with frontier chemistry-AI company Albert Invent to digitalize R&D workflows and give its global scientists access to an AI engine trained on 15M+ molecular structures to design safer, higher-performing consumer-health formulations faster. Work began Q1 2025 as a multi-year rollout to all scientists. [Albert Invent]
deployments_detail.value: AI engine trained on over 15 million molecular structures

deployments_detail.use: Kenvue partnered with Pecan AI (DemandForecast.ai) to build an AI demand-forecasting model combining orders, shipments and POS data with human planner expertise, cutting forecast error and reducing over/understock across its global consumer-health supply chain. [Pecan AI (DemandForecast.ai)]
deployments_detail.value: 37% MAPE reduction in the first year

deployments_detail.use: Kenvue is piloting Microsoft Azure AI for supply-chain and operations optimization, including predictive analytics and digital twins, to create efficiencies across supply chain and operations. [Microsoft Azure AI]
5-yr Microsoft AI collaboration (GenAI, predictive analytics, digital twins) for product dev, supply chain, consumer engagement
Kenvue uses AI within Google Marketing Platform to centralize first-party data, automate marketing tasks and improve personalization, boosting media return on investment. [Google Marketing Platform]

Kenvue applies AI in Amazon Ads / retail-media campaigns to connect media exposure to sales outcomes, reporting lift in sales alongside gains in buyer conversion and basket size (Kelly Shu, director of omni shopper and customer marketing, speaking at ADWEEK House). [Amazon Ads]
deployments_detail.value: more than 30% sales lift, plus increases in buyer conversion and basket size

deployments_detail.use: Kenvue plans algorithmic selling supported by advanced forecasting and intelligent automation (via the Microsoft partnership) to deepen retailer collaboration, improve inventory management and reduce waste. [Microsoft Azure AI]

Kenvue is deploying its Kenvue Content Factory, a new marketing ecosystem (operationally run with Omnicom) that develops content powered by audience intelligence to scale personalized marketing content. [Omnicom (Global Content Factory)]

Under a 5-year Microsoft collaboration, Kenvue is piloting Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio to enhance employee (Kenvuer) productivity and build smart agents for content and internal workflows. [Microsoft (365 Copilot, Copilot Studio)]
